name: selfyz-ai
description: SelfyzAI: an AI visual creation suite. It connects to selfyz.ai through the remote gx-mcp MCP service to animate a single image, create first-to-last-frame transitions, generate videos from text prompts, and create or edit images with text prompts (text-to-image / image-to-image).

interface.longDescription: SelfyzAI connects to selfyz.ai's AI visual creation tools: animate a single image; create smooth first-to-last-frame transitions; generate a video from a text prompt without source media; and create or edit images by changing style, background, or details with a prompt.
defaultPrompt: Turn this photo into a 5-second video
Create a first-to-last-frame transition from these two images
Generate an image from this prompt

positive.description: Checks the signed-in user's credits and membership
positive.prompt: Show my SelfyzAI credit balance and membership status.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the current account's credit balance and membership status from SelfyzAI without creating a task.

positive.description: Quotes a single-image video before generation
positive.prompt: I want to animate one photo into a 5-second video. Show me the supported model options and exact credit cost, but do not create anything yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists available single-image video models, selects a supported 5-second combination, reports the exact credit cost and current balance, and waits for confirmation without creating a task.

positive.prompt: I want to create a fixed first-to-last-frame transition. Show me compatible models and quote the exact cost for default settings, but do not create anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Filters for a model that supports fixed endpoints, validates a concrete aspect ratio for two images, reports the exact credit cost and current balance, and waits for confirmation without creating a task.

positive.prompt: I want to generate a video from this prompt: a paper boat sailing through a neon city at night. Show me the available options and exact credit cost, but do not generate it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists text-to-video models, selects supported defaults, reports the exact credit cost and current balance, and waits for confirmation without creating a task.

positive.prompt: I want to generate an image of a glass greenhouse floating above the clouds. Show me the available options and exact credit cost, but do not generate it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists image-generation models, selects a model that accepts zero input images, reports the exact credit cost and current balance, and waits for confirmation without creating a task.

negative.description: Local image compression is outside SelfyzAI generation workflows
negative.prompt: Resize this local photo to 800 pixels wide and compress it as a JPEG without changing its content.

negative.description: Local video editing is outside SelfyzAI generation workflows
negative.prompt: Trim this existing MP4 to its first ten seconds and convert it to a GIF.

negative.description: A conceptual AI question does not require SelfyzAI tools
negative.prompt: Explain how diffusion models generate images and videos.
